response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile senior engineer with deep open-source involvement, Linux experience, and broad full-stack expertise, but he falls short on two critical requirements: his German is self-rated as basic (the role requires C1 minimum), and his career shows individual-contributor depth rather than the team leadership, client advisory, and executive-level management track record this Head of Development role demands. Python and UML are also absent from his skill set.
strengths: Extensive hands-on software development experience across web, embedded, and high-performance systems
Genuine open-source commitment (founder of GISCollective, D-language libraries, FOSS4G speaker) with strong Linux background
Proven mentoring/knowledge-sharing inclination through workshops, courses, and coding dojos
concerns: German proficiency is 'Basic' — far below the required C1 for a client-facing German consulting role
No demonstrated formal leadership of teams, project management, or executive-level responsibility
Missing key desired skills: Python, UML modeling, and structured requirements/architecture governance experience

key_factors.factor: Strong open-source and Linux engineering background
